description: This PHP class defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) named CandidateActionHistory related to the recruitment module of the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to retrieve accessible candidate action history IDs and IDs relevant for interviewers, based on certain status maps and workflow states.

classes.name: CandidateActionHistory
classes.description: DTO class providing methods to retrieve candidate action history IDs and filtered interview-related IDs based on status maps and workflow states.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateActionHistoryIds
methods.description: Returns an array of candidate action history IDs accessible according to combined status maps.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateHistoryIdsForInterviewer
methods.description: Returns an array of candidate action history IDs accessible to interviewers, filtering out specific actions related to offers and rejection.
